summary: Each core course in microeconomics, macroeconomics and econometrics needs a B- or better, and the History/Institutions field needs a B+ or better. Microeconomic Theory as a field must include ECON 282 or 286. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, the B average in each core sequence and the B expected in other PhD-level courses, and you move in by hand the two breadth courses, the eighth second-year course, and the breadth course that replaces the History Requirement when History is one of your fields. The second-year paper, seminars, teaching, candidacy, oral exam and dissertation are milestones the department records.

patch.desc: This requirement must be completed during the student's second year of study. If history is a student's field of specialization, they will replace this requirement with an additional breadth course (moved in by hand).
